item.title: Van Gogh painting sells for record $190.4 million after Nazi-era restitution dispute resolved
item.description: A Vincent van Gogh painting has set a record after selling for US$190.4 million at a Sotheby’s auction in New York. At its first appearance at auction, the painting Chataigniers en fleurs (Blossoming Chestnut Trees) set the highest price a Van Gogh painting has sold for at auction and the second highest for any artwork sold at Sotheby’s. Gustav Klimt’s Portrait of Elisabeth Lederer holds that honour, sold a year ago at Sotheby’s for US$236.4 million. The Dutch artist painted the landscape scene... item.description: Nigeria has moved a step closer to letting its 36 states set up their own police forces. The National Assembly has sent a constitutional amendment bill to the president, as authorities seek state-run police to complement the federal force amid growing insecurity.
